summary: Contributor-documentation rewrite under the Diataxis adoption design (#133). Rewrite maintained contributor, maintainer, agent, and development pages in ASD-STE100; move hosted-check reference facts from docs/CONTRIBUTING.md to a new reference page; add current context to historical records and ADRs without changing decision IDs or original observations. Correct source comments that disagree with behavior in .ground-control.yaml, .pre-commit-config.yaml, ci.yml, and scripts/install-hooks.sh. Fix defects found during source verification: remove unused lint inputs from the commit-stage policy jobs, classify the merge-queue policy test as Sonar test code, and keep the back-merge token out of process arguments. No Go package, dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, schema, JSON report, exit code, hook stage, or required check changes. See docs/development/contributor-documentation-preflight.md.
trust_boundaries: Review and explicit-path documentation validation remain local or in existing CI. Existing checksum-verified tool downloads do not transfer document contents. The Policy job keeps its read-only checkout and existing GitHub API read for the merge-queue policy; removing unused lint inputs removes no control. The back-merge workflow keeps its existing GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and destination; Git reads the token from the job environment through a credential helper, so the token no longer appears in process arguments. Sonar classification changes only which tracked file counts as test code. No credential file is inspected; no new service, provider, upload, hosting, publication, or external destination is authorized. No runtime environment binding, error envelope, persistence, or application authorization boundary changes.
